rationale: All 10 runs are feasible with wide margins (0 DRC, hold >= +0.08 ns, slew/cap far below the bar), so only setup matters. T_eff tracks the target: the des config fell 8.57 -> 8.06 ns when the target hit the 0.45 floor, yet kept +0.43 ns slack, so the design is not at its wall. Grafting md5's buffering/sizing/TD/post-GRT repair onto it hurt (8.24). With the target floored, the remaining lever is repair margin: setting 1 is the best run with both setup margins at the 0.4 maximum (effective target ~8.09 ns). Setting 2 also packs the floorplan (util 40, density 55%, DRC-clean here in ocs_blitter) to shorten wires, which cap213 shows are costly.
